list.title: Professional standards
list.subtitle: For every law-enforcement profession: labour functions, knowledge and skills, competencies, practice, assessment and career path — in one standard.
list.gridSubtitle: Choose an agency and open a profession standard.

chain.title: From professional standard to career
chain.subtitle: When legislation and state policy change, agency needs, standards and learning content are updated too.
chain.loop: Assessment and passport results are analysed and fed back to update standards and clusters — the system keeps improving.
